target_customer: B2B sales and GTM teams that pay for automated lead lists driven by buying signals such as champion job changes
problem: Reps spend hours on list building and prospect research, and miss warm leads such as past champions who moved to new companies.
business_model: B2B SaaS with a free base tier and paid tiers (about $1,000 a month for extras per a summary of press coverage)

founders.name: Rohan Punamia
founders.background_notes: Sales operations then product management for LinkedIn Talent, per the YC page.

founders.name: Kunal Punera
education: PhD in machine learning, UT Austin
founders.background_notes: Former Director of AI at LinkedIn and founding engineer at RelateIQ.

technical_complexity.rationale: Matching CRM contacts to public profiles and detecting job changes at scale is data engineering with ML ranking, using public data sources.

defensibility.rationale: Signal data came from public sources and rivals sold similar alerts, so the moat was execution and CRM integration.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Salesforce acquired Bluebirds in 2025 per Salesforce coverage.

market_need_then: Job change alerts were a known sales motion sold by vendors, and sales teams were adopting signal-based outbound. Investors backed the pitch with a $5M seed in October 2023.

identity.voice_and_tone: Benefit led, for example save reps 2 hours a day

brand_strength.rationale: Friendly bird name fits the job-change idea of birds moving, but no coverage of the brand was found.

pivots.from: Resell to past customers who changed jobs
pivots.to: Automate outbound with custom intent signals
pivots.why: Positioning changed between YC era and later site copy; reason not stated.

outcome_analysis: Bluebirds had LinkedIn-trained founders, a $5M seed led by Lightspeed in October 2023, and a signals product that grew from job-change tracking into broader intent signals. Salesforce acquired it in 2025. Price and exact date are not public, but a major funded round before the exit points to a stronger outcome than a pure team acquisition.
notes: The $5M amount and investors come from search result text of VentureBeat, FinSMEs and the Lightspeed page (which confirms the seed but not the amount); the VentureBeat page was not fetched directly. Salesforce acquisition date is August 2025 only per one aggregator (unverified), so the date is year only; the Salesforce Ben fetch returned 403 and was not worked around. The pivot date is approximate and flagged as such. Competitor search returned only 2026 vendor pages, so the list is empty. Bluebirds website returned 503 during the fetch.
